options.content: Optimizer objective J, weighted-term contribution fractions (CE, book quality, inventory zone), final weighted components plus objective total, and timing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts AS "time", stage AS metric,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,'value'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,'value'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ARRAY['initial','final','best']) AS stage
WHERE e.topic LIKE 'strategy:diagnostics:%'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,'value'] IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", kv.key AS metric, CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(
  COALESCE(
    e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','objective','contribution_fractions'],
    e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','objective','final','contribution_fractions'],
    '{}'::jsonb
  )
) AS kv
WHERE e.topic LIKE 'strategy:diagnostics:%'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND kv.key IN ('risk_adjusted_return', 'validity_penalty', 'viability_penalty', 'global_validity_penalty', 'global_viability_penalty')
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", kv.key AS metric,
       CASE WHEN kv.key LIKE '%_sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0 ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','timing'], '{}'::jsonb)) AS kv
WHERE e.topic LIKE 'strategy:diagnostics:%'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND trim(kv.value) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", kv.key AS metric, CASE

SELECT e.ts AS "time", kv.key AS metric, CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'

WITH comps AS (
  SELECT e.ts,
         COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','objective','final','components'], '{}'::jsonb) AS c
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic LIKE 'strategy:diagnostics:%'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
)
SELECT ts AS "time", metric, value
FROM (
  SELECT ts,
         'λ applied (local)' AS metric,
         COALESCE(
           NULLIF((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'viability_lambda', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'viability_lambda', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END), 0),
           CASE
             WHEN abs(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'viability_penalty_raw', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'viability_penalty_raw', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0
END) > 1e-15
             THEN abs(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'viability_penalty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'viability_penalty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0
END)
                  / abs(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'viability_penalty_raw', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'viability_penalty_raw', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 1
END)
             ELSE CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'viability_lambda', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'viability_lambda', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END
           END
         ) AS value
  FROM comps
  WHERE c ? 'viability_penalty' OR c ? 'viability_lambda'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ts,
         'λ next (local)' AS metric,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'viability_lambda_learned', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'viability_lambda_learned', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
  FROM comps
  WHERE c ? 'viability_lambda_learned'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ts,
         'λ applied (global)' AS metric,
         COALESCE(
           NULLIF((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'global_viability_lambda', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'global_viability_lambda', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END), 0),
           CASE
             WHEN abs(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'global_viability_penalty_raw', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'global_viability_penalty_raw', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0
END) > 1e-15
             THEN abs(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'global_viability_penalty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'global_viability_penalty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0
END)
                  / abs(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'global_viability_penalty_raw', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'global_viability_penalty_raw', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 1
END)
             ELSE CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'global_viability_lambda', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'global_viability_lambda', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END
           END
         ) AS value
  FROM comps
  WHERE c ? 'global_viability_penalty' OR c ? 'global_viability_lambda'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ts,
         'λ next (global)' AS metric,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'global_viability_lambda_learned', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(c->>'global_viability_lambda_learned', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
  FROM comps
  WHERE c ? 'global_viability_lambda_learned'
) s
WHERE value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time",
       (scope || '.' || kv.key) AS metric,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ARRAY['local_optimizer', 'global_optimizer']) AS scope
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(
  COALESCE(
    e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','config', scope, 'viability'],
    '{}'::jsonb
  )
) AS kv
WHERE e.topic LIKE 'strategy:diagnostics:%'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND kv.key IN ('min_viable_quote', 'margin_buffer', 'availability_target', 'shortfall_tolerance', 'lambda_init', 'lambda_learning_rate')
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", kv.key AS metric, CASE

SELECT e.ts AS "time",
       (scope || '.' || kv.key) AS metric,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ARRAY['local_optimizer', 'global_optimizer']) AS scope
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(
  COALESCE(
    e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','config', scope, 'validity'],
    '{}'::jsonb
  )
) AS kv
WHERE e.topic LIKE 'strategy:diagnostics:%'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND kv.key IN ('min_score', 'penalty_scale')
ORDER BY 1

list.definition:
SELECT exchange
FROM (
  SELECT exchange, max(latest_ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT exchange, updated_at AS latest_ts
  FROM registry_exchanges
  WHERE status = 'active'
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND CAST(exchange AS text) <> ''
  GROUP BY exchange
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC

SELECT run_id
FROM (
  SELECT run_id, max(latest_ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT run_id, max(ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM mm_market_facts
  WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL AND run_id <> ''
    AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  GROUP BY run_id
  ) sources
  WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(run_id AS text) <> ''
  GROUP BY run_id
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC
